items.statement: Within the isolated gas-phase cation model and the four named structures, the calculations support the qualitative CA-IMHB interpretation: twist-boat structures are energetically favored and show close NH+···O contacts with downfield NH+ shifts.
items.expected: Conclusion links the paired energy, distance, and shift comparisons to qualified support for the qualitative hypothesis, while stating that naked-cation gas-phase modeling does not establish solution-phase behavior.
